title: Περὶ ζῴων ἰδιότητος / De natura animalium (On the Characteristics of Animals) / «О природе животных»
author: Claudius Aelianus
size: 17 books, about 900+ short chapters (estimate). Loeb runs to 3 vols.
edition: R. Hercher (Teubner 1864–66; PD). García Valdés et al. (Teubner 2009; in copyright).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Клавдий Элиан) lists only excerpts: Polyakova 1961 (pp. 532–540), Gasparov 1964 (pp. 285–296), Taronyan 2007 (pp. 260–264), Aleksanyan (XI 10–11).
en_evidence: Loeb, A. F. Scholfield, LCL 446, 448, 449 (listed on ru.wikipedia).
other_translations: Reported but not re-verified here: Spanish (Gredos, 1984), Italian (BUR, Maspero 1998), French (Zucker, 2001–02).
value: The richest ancient collection of animal lore: zoology, Egyptian and Indian marvels, moral exempla; source for the Physiologus and bestiaries. Used in history of science, religion and animal studies. Very readable. RU-gap.
ai_feasibility: high: simple narrative prose. Commentary needs zoological identification and source tracing (Aristotle, Ctesias, Megasthenes).
pilot_unit: Book 1 (60 chapters; estimate 7k words) or Book 16 (Indian and eastern animals).
